notes.title: Minor Improvements (Update 1.0.0.2)
notes.notes:
Since the release yesterday we've heard a bit of feedback and put some time into cleaning up the game experience. Here's the short list of changes we made since then!


 The application will remember your previous video and audio settings, these will be applied as soon as you open the application rather than when you reach the title screen.
 Defeating the Fire Wizard on the level 2-4 will not trigger the post-battle cutscene more than once
 Slasher is now spelled correctly in the skill tree (Thanks to YellowAfterLife pointing this out)
 The achievement House of Heads was not originally implemented into the game. This has since been fixed.
 The achievement Duke of Hearts could only be completed when finishing a level. It can now be acquired when looking at the Story Mode menu, completing a level, or when you acquire the tesla tower.


Let us know what you would like to see in future updates!

Yours truly,
Topher and Sebastian

notes.title: The Full Release Is Here!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33290480/56cb5cdd5b6c1710f3fd3917c303c978b9057606.png

Thank you to everyone who has supported us through the development of Duke of Defense. It has been a long road and we've had a lot of great experiences along the way. At last the game is done and ready for you to enjoy!

Now to the most important question... Will there be post-release updates? We would like to and will be working on new content as soon as we finish sorting out console related releases.

Yours truly,
Topher & Sebastian

notes.title: Early Access Full Release (Build 0.9.0.0)
notes.notes:
The full release of the core content for Duke of Defense is here at last! There's currently a lot of time and effort being put into the Switch/Xbox One ports of the game.

We're looking to hear back about bugs and any other issues you hopefully don't experience with this version of the game so that we can get a nice stable build out for the console gamer audience.

New stuff!

 New controller artwork
 The desert hub is now available
 Every level including boss levels show their completion via the platform sprites
 Two new achievements


Thanks everyone!

Yours truly,
Seabass & Topher

notes.title: Small Delay On Next Update!
notes.notes:
We're pushing hard to complete the forest area of the game. We've completed most of the content now but we wanted to include the final boss battle with the Fire Wizard! The next update includes a lot of new content (including some new heads), fixes, and improvements. So hang tight!

Yours truly,
Seabass & Topher

notes.title: The Quality of Life Update (Build 0.3.5.0)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! This is our first official update for Duke of Defense and we want to make sure we've left you with a good impression of what's to come. This update includes mostly quality of life changes that we felt were necessary to take care of before pushing forward with new content.

 New tower upgrade icons
 Added 4 heads to be unlocked (later in the game)
 The tutorial will now prompt you to press SELECT when showing the UI at the top of the screen
 Fixed various grammar issues in the tutorial
 Cannonball impact replaced with fireball impact
 Removed the checkmark displayed above platforms
 Made pausing more polished (just made instances not flash for the first frame)
 Broken hearts appear above the player when taking damage that affects lives and the castle does the same
 Tooltips that appear throughout the gameplay to help explain various mechanics
 New gameplay setting that allows you to turn off automatic menu prompts
 New platforms that indicate a level completion in 3 tiers

 Not completed
 Completed with lives lost
 Completed with no lives lost



We have started work on the next update already so you can definitely expect to see the complete forest section of the game fairly soon. We have another boss battle, new levels, and more heads right around the corner!

Regarding issues with audio problems
We've seen a few reports of music going silent or not looping correctly. We have yet to verify what the exact issue is or what we can do to prevent it. We're keeping our eyes open and looking to resolve this problem as soon as possible.

Yours truly,
Seabass & Topher
